text: Understanding databases is important for anyone who works with data. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which look like spreadsheets with rows and columns. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different formats, such as documents. To get information from a database, you write queries, which are like questions you ask the data. Good data modeling helps you organise your data clearly before you build anything. Finally, indexes make queries faster, just like an index in a book helps you find a page quickly. Learning these basics will help you use databases well.
